description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Ruric Thar.
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, causing target opponent to gain control of Ruric Thar.
Activate the ability granted to Ruric Thar by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Ruric Thar triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
